study.citation: Ghimire SK, Gimenez O, Pradel R, McKey D, Aumeeruddy‐Thomas Y (2008) Demographic variation and population viability in a threatened Himalayan medicinal and aromatic herb Nardostachys grandiflora: matrix modelling of harvesting effects in two contrasting habitats. Journal of Applied Ecology 45:41-51. doi:10.1111/j.1365-2664.2007.01375.x
study.notes: Single rhizome harvest (Sept 1998) at 0/10/25/50/75% in outcrop subplots by local amchi; COMPADRE stores 1999-2002 mean matrices. Meadow (244454) is an unharvested population in a different habitat, not a control for outcrop treatments. COMPADRE altitude (4805 m) differs from paper (3800-4200 m): metadata discrepancy logged.

design_caveat: Randomised harvest treatment with same-population control.
n0_basis: stable stage distribution × 100 (hypothetical; normalised index, not a local stock)
